QuestInfo.name: Prison Guard Boar
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bLuden#k the knight in #bLion King's Castle #m211060800##k.
QuestInfo.1: Luden says monsters setteled in after darkness was cast upon the Lion King's Castle. He tells you to get rid of #rPrison Guard Boar#k in #b#m211060401##k.
QuestInfo.2: You successfully got rid of Prison Guard Boar in #b#m211060401##k.

0.0: Do you still have business in this castle? What? Someone was kidnapped and taken to this castle? I had no idea...
0.1: Though, now that I think about it, there were some new monsters that came in after the darkness was cast. They looked like #rprison guards#k.
0.2: Their presence worsened the already deplorable state of things around here. They must be dealt with swiftly.

yes.0: You already defeated the monster on the roof of the First Tower. Now you just need to get rid of the monster on the roof of the Second Tower. Go to the #bRoof of the Second Tower#k and defeat the #rPrison Guard Boar#k.
yes.1: Then I'll leave it to you.

no.0: This task suits an adventurer such as yourself. Please reconsider.

1.0: Did you defeat Prison Guard Boar? Thank you very much. The castle is a little safer thanks to you.

default.0: Now you just need to get rid of the monster in Roof of the Second Tower. Go to #bRoof of the Second Tower#k and defeat the #rPrison Guard Boar#k.
